name: Auriferous-Dirge
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait a binary sunset, and everything the light never reaches.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
